subject: Hospitality
title: Events as Community Building
description: A short lesson to help you apply Events as Community Building.

hook.text: The loneliest generation craves real connection. Events that build lasting communities—not one-time gatherings.

buildup.text: Recurring events like Burning Man, TED, and South by Southwest created tribes.

discovery.text: Hotels are creating year-round event communities: member clubs, regular dinners.

twist.text: Community requires vulnerability and consistency—things that transactional hospitality doesn't naturally offer.

climax.text: The events industry's future belongs to those who don't just plan gatherings but cultivate belonging.

punchline.text: Gatherings end. Communities endure. The future of events is building tribes that last.

quiz.question: Why are community-building events the future of the industry?
options: A lonely generation craves lasting connection—communities endure beyond single events
